question:

solution:
The mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is place at the right side is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1a72ebf8b45ff75486f3f83a7353937b033187568059b507709702e8e23d7b7.png] 

 
• The line PQ is the mirror.
 
• The given letters and numbers "CQ6RUL" has Q, 6, R and L, so the mirror image should be " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/102425967a1db7fed9566d14e1baf66bc6e027413b1d3d98ce871e3dc58a084f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19a2369ee1a23a5d477aea4e8df2c498cc19fedd3a69a8fe6a9b5ae194fd4120.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a169fdb047d87bccfe1d68ee767746fe4ed7a1aec631cf1541b2275ef5ca4eb.png] " and " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36c46aa92f5c7204b4d882730cfcc349bb77a76d93d8250059d5186e6f9552b3.png] " ⇒ Option 1 is eliminated.
 
• The given numbers "CQ6RUL" has fourth letter R, so the mirror image should be " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/102425967a1db7fed9566d14e1baf66bc6e027413b1d3d98ce871e3dc58a084f.png] " ⇒ Option 2 is eliminated.
 
• The given numbers "CQ6RUL" has third number "7" so the mirror image should be " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b346369fe0bd740614d2c60e6457a26e8c2ec16265926e8248bb038eb696a515.png] " ⇒ Option 4 is eliminated.

Hence, 'option 4' is the correct answer.
